title: Regional Demand Snapshot
description: Aggregated supply/demand/macro signals for one (region, category, period) cell. This is the Market Intelligence Engine's core feature table — not tied to any single listing — feeding both the AI Valuation Engine (regional_fmv/olv/flv) and the Opportunity Engine (regional arbitrage). Rows accumulate over time; consumers query by region+category+period, not by a stable entity id.

computed_at.description: When this row was computed/ingested — the AS-OF key for point-in-time joins (see ml/point_in_time.py and schemas/README.md). Distinct from period.end_date, which describes what the row is *about*, not when it was known; a row can be backfilled well after its period ends, and training joins must use computed_at as the cutoff, not period.end_date.

code.description: CBSA code for metro, ISO 3166-2 for state, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for country, 'GLOBAL' for global.

macro_signals.description: External indicators relevant to this category/region. Not every field applies to every category (e.g. crop_price_index for ag equipment, construction_starts_index for construction equipment).

housing_permits_index.description: Rolling housing-permit issuance index for the region, correlated with construction/compact-equipment demand alongside construction_starts_index. Referenced by ml/models/exit_price_model.py's FEATURE_COLUMNS and PRD.md's Market Intelligence Engine inputs.

fuel_price_usd_per_gallon.description: Regional retail diesel/fuel price. Distinct from macro_signals.national_diesel_reference below, which is a national freight-industry benchmark, not a regional retail price.

weather_events.description: e.g. hurricane, drought, flood — drives demand spikes for generators, pumps, etc.

load_to_truck_ratio.description: DAT Trendlines-style ratio of active shipping requests to available flatbed trucks. High ratio signals intense regional freight/machinery-movement activity and rising equipment demand; low ratio signals cooling.

national_diesel_reference.description: National diesel price benchmark (e.g. DOE/DAT reference), feeding logistics_friction.transport.fuel_surcharge_pct. A national figure, not regional — populate only on rows where region.level = 'global' rather than duplicating it across every metro/state row.

infrastructure_pipeline_value.description: $ volume of ongoing public infrastructure works in the region (e.g. Dodge Construction Network), monthly.

fleet_smr_delta.description: Signed trend in aggregated regional fleet operating-hour (SMR) accumulation, e.g. from Rouse Benchmark. Signals local fleet usage intensity and upcoming maintenance-cycle timing.

forecast.description: Model-generated projections, computed from this and prior snapshots. Never hand-entered.
